title: Milo Learns His ABCs With Animals

scenes.prompt: Bright colorful 3D cartoon animation for babies and toddlers. Milo, a cute friendly blue teddy bear mascot with soft sky-blue fur, round teddy bear ears, a light blue tummy, big friendly eyes, a small cute nose, and a happy smiling face, stands beside a cute baby alligator and a giant uppercase letter A. Milo points excitedly at the letter A and the alligator. Rounded soft shapes, vibrant rainbow colors, simple uncluttered preschool background, cheerful educational style, gentle playful movement.
scenes.narration: Milo found A! A is for Alligator! Alligator!
